visual.name: appleGlobe
visual.description: Interactive 3D revenue globe with a live day/night Earth, market markers, region highlighting and report-level cross-filtering. Built for the Apple FY2021-FY2025 geographic dataset and adaptable to other markets via optional latitude and longitude fields.

dataRoles.name: country
dataRoles.description: Market name. The thirteen Apple reporting hubs are recognised automatically, including common aliases.

dataRoles.name: revenue
dataRoles.description: Revenue in USD millions. Aggregated by market and by fiscal year when the Fiscal Year field is present.

dataRoles.name: year
dataRoles.description: Optional. Adds growth, period labels and year-driven filter behaviour.

dataRoles.name: region
dataRoles.description: Optional. Overrides the region inferred from the market registry.

dataRoles.name: city
dataRoles.description: Optional. Adds a location label to tooltips and market detail.

dataRoles.name: latitude
dataRoles.description: Optional. Latitude in decimal degrees. Leave blank to use the built-in registry coordinates.

dataRoles.name: longitude
dataRoles.description: Optional. Longitude in decimal degrees. Leave blank to use the built-in registry coordinates.

autoRotate.description: Rotate the globe automatically when it is idle.

autoRotateSpeed.description: 1 is the default speed. Values below 1 slow the globe down.

startAngle.description: Longitude the camera returns to when the view is reset.

markerScale.description: Scales every market marker on the globe.

}

.ag-hero-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55em;
  margin-top: 0.22em;
  min-height: 1.2em;
}
.ag-total {
  color: #f4f9ff;
  font-size: 2.72em;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  line-height: 1;
  text-shadow: 0 0.14em 0.6em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);

}
.ag-pill {

  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.28em;
  padding: 0.27em 0.55em;
  border: 1px solid rgba(78, 219, 175, 0.24);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(78, 219, 175, 0.1);

  letter-spacing: 0.015em;
}

.ag-chip .ag-chip-pct { color: #d7e5f8; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ag-chip.is-active { border-color: var(--c); background: var(--c-soft); color: #ffffff; }
.ag-chip.is-muted { opacity: 0.4; }

.ag-topcard {
  position: absolute;
  right: 1.25em;
  bottom: 1.1em;
  z-index: 5;
  min-width: 8.5em;
  max-width: 15em;
  padding: 0.65em 0.8em;
  border: 1px solid rgba(137, 176, 234, 0.14);
  border-radius: 0.7em;
  background: rgba(6, 13, 25, 0.58);
  box-shadow: 0 0.5em 1.5em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.ag-top-label {
  color: #8fa7c9;
  font-size: 0.57em;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.ag-top-body { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.7em; margin-top: 0.22em; }
.ag-top-country {
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #f1f7ff;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ag-top-value {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #f1f7ff;
  font-size: 1.02em;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ag-top-share { margin-top: 0.18em; color: #8fa7c9; font-size: 0.6em; }

.ag-hint {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 1.35em;
  z-index: 4;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  color: rgba(160, 181, 208, 0.58);
  font-size: 0.58em;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.13em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
}
.ag-hint.is-hidden { opacity: 0; }

.ag-labels { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 3; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; }
.ag-label {
  position: absolute;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.38em;
  max-width: 15em;
  opacity: 0;
  color: rgba(232, 243, 255, 0.9);
  font-size: 0.62em;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: 0.065em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: 0 0.1em 0.45em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity 0.18s ease;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}
.ag-label.is-visible { opacity: 1; }
.ag-label .ag-label-dot {
  width: 0.32em;
  height: 0.32em;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0.5em var(--c);
}
.ag-label .ag-label-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.05em; min-width: 0; }
.ag-label .ag-label-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ag-label .ag-label-value {
  color: rgba(198, 217, 240, 0.72);
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.015em;
  text-transform: none;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ag-label.is-selected { color: #ffffff; }
.ag-label.is-left { flex-direction: row-reverse; }

.ag-tooltip {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 10;
  width: 15em;
  max-width: 78%;
  padding: 0.9em 0.95em 0.8em;
  border: 1px solid rgba(137, 176, 234, 0.2);
  border-radius: 0.85em;
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(13, 24, 42, 0.97), rgba(5, 11, 22, 0.98));
  box-shadow: 0 1em 2.5em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(0.3em) scale(0.985);
  transition: opacity 0.14s ease, transform 0.14s ease, visibility 0.14s;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.ag-tooltip.is-visible { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
.ag-tt-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.55em; }
.ag-tt-dot {
  width: 0.5em;
  height: 0.5em;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-top: 0.35em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0.6em var(--c);
}
.ag-tt-country { color: #f3f8ff; font-size: 0.98em; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.ag-tt-place { margin-top: 0.14em; color: #8fa7c9; font-size: 0.65em; }
.ag-tt-value {
  margin-top: 0.55em;
  color: #f6faff;
  font-size: 1.55em;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  line-height: 1.1;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ag-tt-meta {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.4em;
  margin-top: 0.55em;
  padding-top: 0.55em;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(137, 176, 234, 0.12);
}
.ag-tt-meta span {
  display: block;
  color: #8fa7c9;
  font-size: 0.57em;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.ag-tt-meta strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.1em;
  color: #e2edfb;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ag-tt-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45em; margin-top: 0.55em; }
.ag-tt-growth {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25em;
  padding: 0.2em 0.45em;
  border: 1px solid rgba(78, 219, 175, 0.2);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(78, 219, 175, 0.08);
  color: #75e7c2;
  font-size: 0.6em;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ag-tt-growth.neg { border-color: rgba(255, 126, 157, 0.2); background: rgba(255, 126, 157, 0.08); color: #ff9ab1; }
.ag-tt-cta {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: rgba(111, 168, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 0.55em;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ag-empty {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 7;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 1.5em;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.ag-empty[hidden] { display: none; }
.ag-empty-card {
  width: min(22em, 88%);
  padding: 1.1em 1.25em;
  border: 1px solid rgba(137, 176, 234, 0.18);
  border-radius: 0.9em;
  background: rgba(7, 14, 26, 0.84);
  box-shadow: 0 1em 3em rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  text-align: center;
}
.ag-empty-title { color: #eef5ff; font-size: 0.95em; font-weight: 650; }
.ag-empty-body { margin-top: 0.35em; color: #93a9c6; font-size: 0.68em; line-height: 1.6; }
.ag-empty-body strong { color: #cfe0f7; font-weight: 600; }

.ag-sr {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-head { top: 0.95em; left: 1.05em; }
.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-total { font-size: 2.25em; }
.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-sub { margin-top: 0.35em; font-size: 0.64em; }
.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-actions { top: 0.8em; right: 0.9em; }
.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-legend { left: 1em; bottom: 0.8em; }
.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-chip { padding: 0.3em 0.45em; font-size: 0.6em; }
.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-topcard,
.ag-root.ag-compact .ag-hint { display: none; }

.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-kicker { display: none; }
.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-head { top: 0.75em; left: 0.85em; max-width: 58%; }
.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-total { font-size: 1.9em; }
.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-sub { display: none; }
.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-actions { top: 0.55em; right: 0.6em; padding: 0.2em; }
.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-btn { width: 1.9em; height: 1.9em; min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px; }
.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-legend { display: none; }
.ag-root.ag-tiny .ag-label { font-size: 0.58em; }

.ag-root.ag-no-kpi .ag-head { display: none; }
.ag-root.ag-no-legend .ag-legend { display: none; }
.ag-root.ag-no-topcard .ag-topcard { display: none; }
.ag-root.ag-no-hint .ag-hint { display: none; }

@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .ag-btn { min-width: 34px; min-height: 34px; }
  .ag-chip { min-height: 28px; }
}
